test_title: PYST 29: SSC GD Constable 2024 - Reasoning (Held On: 28 Feb, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: Five colleagues Alok, Bhavana, Chetan, Divya, and Ekta are seated at a circular table facing the center. Chetan, who is sitting to the immediate left of Ekta, is also second to the right of Divya. Bhavana is not sitting next to Chetan. Who is sitting second to the right of Bhavana?
solution:
Given: Five colleagues Alok, Bhavana, Chetan, Divya, and Ekta.

Chetan, who is sitting to the immediate left of Ekta, is also second to the right of Divya.

Bhavana is not sitting next to Chetan.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f188f48cebea6ff7a64725d82bd4d1ec716730094935e043bfc300f4ed3f7ff0.png] 

So, **Alok **is sitting second to the right of Bhavana.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Alok".**
